definition: `CanBe x r`: x is able to be r, as the knower who is not contemplating is able to contemplate and the wood is able to have the Hermes cut out of it. A primitive of the Metaphysics IX.6 analysis of potency; it says nothing about whether x is actually r, and nothing in the case constrains it beyond that analysis.
note: Sense fork batch 3 (POTENCY_3): CapacityPotency CanBe x r := CanBe x r is the sense's own declaration, so that capacity statements mention neither adopted nor independent potency. The CanBe parameter of PotencyIsUnactualizedCapacityReading is the same relation.
